rules.statement: Every accepted lifecycle transition records actor, reason, source revision, resulting revision, and event time.
A stable request identity converges on one scientific effect when its content fingerprint remains identical.
Custody position, custody event, and pending integration message become visible through one transaction boundary.
Raw bytes, content digest, parsed observation, disposition, and recovery owner remain linked.
Sapio qualification binds tenant release, SDK release, schema fingerprint, service identity, and independent readback.
Benchling event processing commits durable inbox work and retrieves authoritative resource state when freshness matters.
LabKey validation, commit, audit reason, normalized readback, lineage, and artifact parity form one conformance tranche.
Migration gates evaluate identity, canonical content, relationships, audit, signatures, artifacts, exceptions, and rollback.
A clean-environment restore reconstructs records, metadata, audit, signatures, artifacts, configuration, and approved recovery objectives.
Identity, authorization, tenant, retention, and redaction decisions remain attributable and testable.

Environment-scoped workload identities resolve non-secret configuration from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and rotating secret material from AWS Secrets Manager; KMS context, version stage, cache bounds, redacted retrieval telemetry, and repository build state log and fixture reference posture remain testable.
Operational measures preserve numerator, denominator, threshold, window, and evidence locator.
Scientific, Quality, Regulatory, Security, Operations, and business owners accept the scope governed by their authority.
